capabilities: Display creation and update dates in the note header with locale or Moment.js formatting
Render frontmatter properties as custom fields or pills, with folder-scoped visibility
Show a clickable breadcrumb path to the note's folder
Build tab navigation that links related notes via a shared frontmatter property
Add a color-customizable scroll progress bar at the top of notes
extras: The README includes a disclaimer crediting Antigravity for code assistance and invites bug reports and pull requests; the interface is translated into five languages.
motivation: The author wanted a more elegant, 'published' feel for their own vault and spent time customizing it to their liking.
problem: Obsidian shows note metadata only as plain properties, with no blog-style header in the note view for dates, paths, and related-note navigation.

relations.evidence: Running Head also seamlessly integrates with the Typify plugin to automatically inherit premium colored pill styles.

summary: Adds a customizable header above note content showing dates, frontmatter fields, folder path, tab navigation, and a scroll progress bar.
